business_problem: Pandora needed to bring its high-touch in-store storytelling, gift guidance, and service quality into digital channels while coping with seasonal support spikes and a fragmented ecommerce architecture.
solution_summary: Pandora is building an agentic commerce and service stack that recreates its in-store experience online. Agentforce powers Gemma, a personal shopper agent that uses Commerce Cloud product and order history together with Data 360 context to ask about the occasion, recipient, and budget, then recommend jewelry in Pandora's own tone. The same platform also supports Clara, a service agent that answers order-status and care questions by combining Service Cloud with Commerce Cloud fulfillment data. MuleSoft connects the broader commerce environment so personalized recommendations and service answers are grounded in the right customer and order context, and Loyalty Management extends that same data to promotions across key markets. By unifying commerce, service, and loyalty on one Salesforce-centered platform, Pandora can personalize more interactions without recreating the rigid chatbots and fragmented systems it wanted to leave behind.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Runs Pandora's shopping and service agents for guided recommendations and automated support.

solution_components.name: Commerce Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides product, order, and storefront context for ecommerce interactions.

solution_components.name: Data 360
solution_components.role: Supplies unified customer and interaction data used to personalize recommendations.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Gives service agents access to shopper history and case context.

solution_components.name: MuleSoft
solution_components.role: Connects commerce data and downstream systems inside Pandora's digital architecture.

solution_components.name: Loyalty Management
solution_components.role: Turns customer data into personalized loyalty offers across multiple markets.

data_flow: Product, order, and shopper data from Commerce Cloud and connected systems is unified through Data 360 and MuleSoft. Agentforce uses that context to power Gemma and Clara, while Service Cloud supports hand-offs and Loyalty Management turns the same customer view into personalized promotions.
business_outcome: Pandora improved digital recommendation quality, automated a large share of routine service interactions, and created a platform for loyalty and ecommerce growth that still feels personal to shoppers.
metrics: 22% of total sales handled through Commerce Cloud
architecture_clues: Gemma uses order history, product data, recommendation signals, and research insights to personalize shopping guidance.
Clara uses fulfillment data from IBM Sterling through connected Commerce Cloud workflows.
Pandora is moving toward a composable PWA Kit-based storefront architecture.
